product.name: Monoprice PTZ Video Conference Camera Pan Tilt Zoom with Remote Full HD 1080p Webcam USB 2.0 10x Optical Zoom
product.description: This Pan‑Tilt‑Zoom (PTZ) Conferencing Camera is designed for video broadcast and conferencing from larger halls and bigger conference rooms. The powerful 10x optical zoom brings subjects closer, making it perfect for lectures or church services. It works with computer based video conferencing apps and cloud services and is designed to be easy to install and use for web meetings.This camera is easy to setup for use with computers. It uses a standard USB 2.0 connection, so it works with most laptops and desktops. There is only one cable to plug in. No separate power, video, or control cables are needed. It is plug and play, so no separate drivers are needed for Windows®, macOS®, Chrome OS™, and Linux®. Simply enable the camera through your operating system or conferencing app.The camera's video capabilities are specifically designed for meetings, lectures, and live event webcasts, with an 54 degree field of view. The motorized pan, tilt, and zoom functions allow it to zoom in or out when needed with the touch of a button on the included remote control. The 1/2.9" Sony® CMOS sensor is designed to use ambient office lighting, while the 1080p HD video resolution balances HD video quality with data bandwidth requirements.The included remote control provides easy control for pan, tilt, and zoom movements and allows for presets to be saved to automatically zoom in to predetermined points in the meeting room. Advanced controls can be achieved through third party software or control devices (not included).This PTZ camera includes mounting hardware, so it can be easily installed on meeting room walls next to a TV or monitor. A 16.4‑foot USB cable is included and can be actively extended using Monoprice Active USB 2.0 Extension Cable (sold separately).Features: Designed for larger halls, lectures, churches, and board roomsUSB 2.0 connection for power, video, and audioNo drivers required for Windows®, macOS®, Chrome OS™, or Linux®Compatible with popular internet based video conferencing softwareVideo optimized for web meetings and webcastingIncludes a wireless remote control for PTZ control, with the ability to save preset angles and zoomsBest when used with an external mic and speaker (sold separately)Mounting hardware included Monoprice™, WORKSTREAM™, the WORKSTREAM logo, and all Monoprice logos are trademarks of Monoprice Inc.
